name: state.announce: hunk with inverted range is wire-accepted; daemon enforces semantic constraint
description: JSON Schema cannot express the cross-field invariant `end_line >= start_line`. The wire schema accepts this hunk; the TAP daemon enforces the invariant before adding it to its hunk diff tracker. This fixture pins that wire-level acceptance so implementations agree on the layer at which the invariant lives.
notes: See common.cue #Hunk for the rationale: JSON Schema cannot enforce sibling-field comparisons. The daemon's hunk diff tracker rejects inverted ranges; conformance for that layer is tested in Phase 2.
